title: Counter-hold a loaded trailer hand winch crank while flipping its ratchet pawl to pay out one slack tick
instruction: Hold the red winch crank with one hand, flip the blue ratchet pawl into the magenta pocket with the other, then turn the crank to let the strap out until the black strap mark sits between the red tabs, without touching or coming within 5 mm of the orange sled or yellow strap, and finish with both hands clear of the winch.
context: Trailer boaters and utility-trailer owners ease strap tension on a geared hand winch by counter-holding the crank under preload, flipping a spring-biased reversing pawl to neutral, then metering a short strap release to a mark without freewheel snapback.
setup: Station table coordinates in metres: x forward from the arm-base line, y left, h up from the table top (world z = 0.7475 + h). Arm bases at (0.000, +0.305) and (0.000, -0.305). Fixed powder-coated steel bench plate 0.460 x 0.180 x 0.010 m, centre (0.3600, 0.0000, h=0.0050), sRGB (0.22, 0.24, 0.27). Fixed galvanized steel winch riser/U-frame (sRGB 0.76, 0.78, 0.80): plinth 0.130 x 0.080 x 0.040 m at (0.2350, 0.0000, h=0.0300), rear column 0.020 x 0.080 x 0.075 m at (0.1750, 0.0000, h=0.0875), and two U-frame cheeks 0.120 x 0.008 x 0.170 m at (0.2400, +-0.0360, h=0.1600) with 0.025 m lower gussets down to h=0.0500. Yellow steel drum spool (0.096 m wrapped OD, r_eff=0.048 m, 0.056 m wide, 0.114 m flanges, mass 0.650 kg) on +y revolute at (0.2600, 0.0000, h=0.1275) with a 49-tooth steel drum spur gear (0.1476 m OD x 0.010 m at y=+0.024), two black 0.014 x 0.004 x 0.040 m reset spokes at 0 deg and +30 deg on the +y flange (behind the cheek, used only to reset by hand), and a fixed red printed PLA 12 x 12 x 20 mm drum index pointer at (0.2600, +0.0360, h=0.1885). Steel pinion shaft at (0.2150, 0.0000, h=0.2075) coupled 4.1:1 to the drum (mass 0.280 kg total): 12-tooth spur pinion (0.036 m OD x 0.010 m), greased steel 12-tooth ratchet wheel (0.058 m OD x 0.008 m at y=-0.0460), steel crank arm bar 0.200 x 0.018 x 0.010 m at y=+0.0550 tilted +40 deg above +x at start, and red knurled handle sleeve 0.026 m OD x 0.070 m long at start centre (0.3514, +0.1050, h=0.3219). Blue plastic pawl paddle 0.014 x 0.012 x 0.052 m, mass 0.055 kg, hinge at (0.1920, -0.0560, h=0.2445), start theta_pawl=0 deg over green UP mouth window 0.014 x 0.004 x 0.014 m at (0.1920, -0.0440, h=0.2725); magenta DOWN mouth window 0.014 x 0.004 x 0.014 m at (0.1748, -0.0440, h=0.2666), both on a black 0.040 x 0.002 x 0.030 m bezel plate; pawl pivot lug 0.010 x 0.022 x 0.008 m at (0.1920, -0.0510, h=0.2445); 12 mm axles through the cheeks at the pinion and drum centres; 0.120 x 0.012 x 0.020 m steel carriage key on the rail. Yellow 50 mm polyester strap 0.155 x 0.050 x 0.003 m along +x at (0.3375, 0.0000, h=0.0750) with black vinyl stripe 0.014 x 0.052 x 0.006 m, mass 0.005 kg, start (0.3400, 0.0000, h=0.0795); flanking red steel target tabs 0.008 x 0.020 x 0.010 m at (0.3650, +-0.0380, h=0.0795). Aluminum linear rail 0.240 x 0.030 x 0.013 m at (0.4700, 0.0000, h=0.0585) carrying orange bow-load sled 0.080 x 0.056 x 0.030 m, mass 0.850 kg, start (0.4550, 0.0000, h=0.0800) with 1,804 N/m spring toward x=0.4800 (45.1 N preload); green printed PLA chock 0.020 x 0.070 x 0.035 m at (0.5300, 0.0000, h=0.0800), front face x=0.5200. Nominal end: blue paddle in magenta mouth (theta_pawl in [33, 43] deg), stripe at x=0.3650 within 5 mm, sled x in [0.4780, 0.4800], drum turned 30 deg (+-5 deg), both hands open and clear.
scoring: SCORE_OVER=end; SUCCESS_HOLD_S=0.05 s (1 step). The 1.0 s clear-rest hold (20 consecutive steps at 20 Hz) is counted inside score(): score() returns 1.00 on the 20th consecutive clear-rest step and success() is true from then on while the clear frame still holds, so a correct run ends with score 1.0 and success together. Latched violations (permanent 0.0 for the episode): (1) pawl_flipped_unbraced: while x_sled<0.4780 and theta_pawl>10 deg without crank_held_active; (2) runaway_freewheel: unbraced with x_sled<0.4780 and the drum turns >4 deg in one 0.05 s step (strap visibly pays out by itself); (3) sled_or_strap_tampered: gripper TCP, tip, or pad volume contact or <5 mm clearance to orange sled, yellow strap or black stripe, or sled h>0.088, or unbraced sled |dx|>2 mm in one step or >3 mm cumulative path (also if |x-braced|>3 mm); (4) overshoot_or_wind_wrong: x_stripe outside [0.3320, 0.3780] or drum past -45 deg. crank_held_active: pad-to-pad opening in [0.020, 0.0275] m on the 26 mm sleeve (jaws visibly closed on the sleeve), gripper centre within 22 mm of the sleeve axis with y in [0.075, 0.135], opposing pads straddling the sleeve axis along the jaw-closing vector, closing vector within 30 deg of the x-z plane. magenta_seated: theta_pawl in [33, 43] deg and blue paddle centre within 5 mm of magenta mouth in the x-h plane with |y+0.056|<=8 mm. Ladder (no violations): instantaneous 0.25 (debug/mid-episode only) is crank counter-hold with the drum within 5 deg of its start angle (crank at its +40 deg start) and x_stripe in [0.3350, 0.3450] and x_sled<=0.4580; 0.50 hold continuous while magenta_seated with the same start drum/stripe band (latches L_050); 0.75 requires L_050 intact, the same holding arm crank_held_active on every step from before theta_pawl>10 deg through stripe alignment, drum turned 24 to 36 deg in payout (crank turned about 98 to 148 deg at the 4.1:1 ratio), |x_stripe-0.3650|<=5 mm, x_sled in [0.4780, 0.4800], pawl stays magenta; 1.00 is the 0.75 state with everything visibly at rest (<10 mm/s, <0.5 rad/s), both grippers open (>=50 mm) and TCP/pad surfaces >=50 mm clear of all winch, crank, pawl, strap, stripe and sled surfaces, held for 20 consecutive steps. score() = min(instantaneous tier, end_cap): end_cap 0.00 without L_magenta, 0.50 without L_payout, 0.75 until the 20-step clear-rest hold completes, then 1.00; after that clamp any result below 0.50 becomes 0.00 so 0.25 never survives episode end (including after L_magenta if the pawl leaves the band). Photo/tape: stripe within 5 mm of red tabs; drum angle from the crank angle in the video (4.1:1); sled-chock gap <=2 mm; magenta paddle seating; open clear hands for 1.0 s.
reset_notes: Wind the red crank CCW until the 0 deg spoke aligns with the red pointer, stripe at x=0.3400 m, sled at x_sled=0.4550 m; flip the blue pawl into green UP (0 deg, paddle centre within 5 mm of green mouth (0.1920, -0.0440, h=0.2725) in x-h); verify the ratchet holds hands-free; inspect the strap wrap. Replace the black vinyl stripe if worn. Reuse the printed bezel and bracket; replace the spring only if set length drifts >2 mm.
fidelity: Simulated in Isaac Lab-Arena / Inspect Robots with rigid-body contacts and approximated winch/pawl/cable mechanics; cable tension, compliance, and micro-slip are simplified rather than full FEA. Demo uses permitted camera observations without privileged simulator state; detailed parameters, tolerances, and simplifications are documented in README.md.
